verdicts.decision_note: The client requires executable HVAC sizing calculations and explicitly excludes Title 24 work; the unrelated project kickoff deadline is not represented.
The freelancer raises a material scope uncertainty about whether the requested calculations are included beyond review and stamping.

The client defines the calculation deliverable as the applicable Manual J, Manual S, and Manual D analyses; these remain consistent with the existing HVAC sizing requirement and make no prior key obsolete.
The client's target-specific clarification resolves the calculation-scope uncertainty and returns the Manual J/S/D deliverable to active status.
